🎥🎬: Futurama (1999–Present)

Fry thought he was just delivering another pizza on New Year’s Eve in 1999, but one strange accident sends him 1,000 years into the future. Suddenly surrounded by flying cars, aliens, robots, and technology he barely understands, Fry gets the chance to completely reinvent his life.

His new beginning leads him to Planet Express, where he joins Leela, Bender, and an unpredictable crew tasked with delivering packages across the galaxy. What should be a simple delivery job constantly turns into wild adventures involving strange civilizations, dangerous planets, time travel, and some of the universe’s weirdest characters.

Behind the sci-fi chaos, Futurama follows a group of unlikely friends navigating life, relationships, and one ridiculous crisis after another in a future where almost anything can happen.

Stream an all-new season of Futurama August 3 on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

source_details.synopsis: Futurama is an American animated science fiction sitcom created by Matt Groening and developed by Groening and David X. Cohen for the Fox Broadcasting Company, and later revived by Comedy Central and then Hulu. The series follows Philip J. Fry, a young man who is cryogenically preserved for 1,000 years and revived on December 31, 2999. Fry finds work at the interplanetary delivery company Planet Express, working alongside the one-eyed mutant Leela and the robot Bender. The series was envisioned by Groening in the mid-1990s while working on The Simpsons; he brought Cohen, a Simpsons writer, aboard to develop storylines and characters to pitch the show to Fox.
